## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<short-description>` (e.g. `fix/order-book-resync`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...)
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Public API changes are documented (README / rustdoc)
- [ ] Release: version bumped in `Cargo.toml` and the pinned version in `README.md` (only for a release PR; the tag is created by CI after merge)
